actions.description: Start an asset upload job from raw bytes.
actions.name: create-asset-upload-job

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes to upload. Example: "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="

name.description: The asset name. Maximum 50 characters. Example: "My Awesome Upload"

actions.description: Create a reply to an inline annotation comment.
actions.name: create-comment-reply

designId.description: The ID of the design the comment is on. Example: "DAFVztcvd9z"

commentId.description: The ID of the inline annotation comment. Example: "KeAZEAjijEb"

message_plaintext.description: The reply message in plaintext. Example: "Thanks!"

actions.description: Create an inline annotation comment on a specific design element
actions.name: create-comment

type.description: The type of object to attach the comment to. Example: "design"

design_id.description: The ID of the design to attach the comment to. Example: "DAHNACmCy_g"

element.description: Reference to the specific design element to anchor the comment to

attached_to.description: The object to attach the comment to

message_plaintext.description: The comment message in plaintext. Example: "Great work!"

assignee_id.description: The ID of the user to assign the comment to. Example: "oUnPjZ2k2yuhftbWF7873o"

actions.description: Create a reply in a design comment thread.
actions.name: create-design-comment-reply

design_id.description: The ID of the design. Example: "DAHNACmCy_g"

thread_id.description: The ID of the comment thread. Example: "KAHNAKVJAd4"

message_plaintext.description: The reply message in plaintext. Example: "Thanks for the feedback!"

actions.description: Create a floating comment thread on a design.
actions.name: create-design-comment

design_id.description: The ID of the design to comment on. Example: "DAHNACmCy_g"

message_plaintext.description: The comment message in plaintext. Example: "Great work!"

assignee_id.description: The User ID to assign the comment to. You must mention this user in the message.

actions.description: Create an export job for a design.
actions.name: create-design-export-job

format.description: Export format details including type and format-specific options.

actions.description: Start a binary design import job
actions.name: create-design-import-job

title.description: The title of the design to create. Maximum 50 characters. Example: "My Imported Design"

file_content.description: Base64-encoded file content. Supported formats: PPTX, PDF, SVG. Example: "PHN2Zy4u."

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the file being imported. If not provided, Canva attempts to automatically detect the type. Example: "application/pdf"

actions.description: Start a design resize job.
actions.name: create-design-resize-job

design_id.description: The ID of the design to resize. Example: "DAHNACmCy_g"

actions.description: Create a design from a preset design type or custom dimensions
actions.name: create-design

name.description: The preset design type name. Example: "presentation"

width.description: The width of the design in pixels. Example: 1920

height.description: The height of the design in pixels. Example: 1080

design_type.description: The design type, either a preset or custom dimensions

asset_id.description: The ID of an asset to insert into the created design. Currently only supports image assets. Example: "MAHNAIYJM-w"

title.description: The name of the design. Example: "My Holiday Presentation"

actions.description: Create a folder.
actions.name: create-folder

name.description: The name of the folder. Example: "My awesome holiday"

parent_folder_id.description: The folder ID of the parent folder. Use "root" for top-level or "uploads" for the Uploads folder. Example: "FAF2lZtloor"

name.description: The folder name. Example: "My awesome holiday"

created_at.description: When the folder was created, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

updated_at.description: When the folder was last updated, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

width.description: The width of the thumbnail image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the thumbnail image in pixels.

url.description: A URL for retrieving the thumbnail image.

actions.description: Start an asset upload job from a source URL.
actions.name: create-url-asset-upload-job

url.description: The URL of the file to import. Must be publicly accessible and return HTTP 200 directly. Example: "https://example.com/image.jpg"

name.description: A name for the asset. Example: "My Awesome Asset"

actions.description: Start a design import job from a source URL.
actions.name: create-url-design-import-job

url.description: The URL of the file to import. Must be publicly accessible. Example: "https://example.com/presentation.pptx"

title.description: A title for the imported design. Example: "My Awesome Design"

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the file being imported. Example: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation"

actions.description: Delete an asset.
actions.name: delete-asset

assetId.description: The ID of the asset to delete. Example: "MAHNAO5uFww"

actions.description: Delete a folder.
actions.name: delete-folder

actions.description: Retrieve asset upload job status/result.
actions.name: get-asset-upload-job

jobId.description: The asset upload job ID. Example: "e08861ae-3b29-45db-8dc1-1fe0bf7f1cc8"

actions.description: Retrieve asset metadata.
actions.name: get-asset

assetId.description: The ID of the asset. Example: "MAHNAIYJM-w"

actions.description: Retrieve brand template metadata.
actions.name: get-brand-template

actions.description: Retrieve current Canva user capabilities.
actions.name: get-current-user-capabilities

actions.description: Retrieve current Canva user profile details.
actions.name: get-current-user-profile

actions.description: Retrieve the current Canva user.
actions.name: get-current-user

team_id.description: The ID of the user's Canva Team.

actions.description: Retrieve one reply in a design comment thread.
actions.name: get-design-comment-reply

threadId.description: The ID of the thread. Example: "KAHNAKVJAd4"

replyId.description: The ID of the reply. Example: "KAHNAD33dXY"

actions.description: Retrieve a design comment thread.
actions.name: get-design-comment-thread

design_id.description: The ID of the design. Example: "DAFVztcvd9z"

thread_id.description: The ID of the comment thread. Example: "KeAbiEAjZEj"

actions.description: List export formats available for a design.
actions.name: get-design-export-formats

actions.description: Retrieve export job status/result and download URLs.
actions.name: get-design-export-job

actions.description: Retrieve design import job status/result.
actions.name: get-design-import-job

jobId.description: The ID of the design import job. Example: "e80335c7-afa5-4608-a815-4865c11d0025"

actions.description: List pages in a design.
actions.name: get-design-pages

offset.description: The page index to start from (1-based). Defaults to 1.

limit.description: The number of pages to return. Defaults to 50.

actions.description: Retrieve design metadata.
actions.name: get-design

actions.description: Retrieve folder metadata.
actions.name: get-folder

actions.description: Retrieve URL asset upload job status and result.
actions.name: get-url-asset-upload-job

job_id.description: The asset upload job ID. Example: "e08861ae-3b29-45db-8dc1-1fe0bf7f1cc8"

actions.description: Retrieve URL design import job status/result.
actions.name: get-url-design-import-job

jobId.description: The ID of the URL import job. Example: "e08861ae-3b29-45db-8dc1-1fe0bf7f1cc8"

actions.description: List brand templates.
actions.name: list-brand-templates

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

query.description: Search term or terms to filter brand templates.

limit.description: The number of brand templates to return. Defaults to 25.

continuation.description: Pagination cursor for the next page.

actions.description: List replies in a design comment thread.
actions.name: list-design-comment-replies

threadId.description: The ID of the thread. Example: "KAHNAKVJAd4"

limit.description: The number of replies to return. Maximum 100.

continuation.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List design metadata with optional text search, type, and ownership filters.
actions.name: list-designs

query.description: Search term to filter designs. Example: "party invites"

ownership.description: Filter by ownership: any, owned, or shared.

continuation.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Example: "RkFGMgXlsVTDbMd:MR3L0QjiaUzycIAjx0yMyuNiV0OildoiOwL0x32G4NjNu4FwtAQNxowUQNMMYN"

limit.description: Number of designs to return (1-100). Default: 25.

actions.description: Move a folder item to another folder.
actions.name: move-folder-item

item_id.description: The ID of the item to move. Example: "DAHNACmCy_g"

to_folder_id.description: The ID of the destination folder. Example: "FAHNA0uMKHU"

actions.description: Update asset name and tags.
actions.name: update-asset

assetId.description: The ID of the asset to update. Example: "MAHNAIYJM-w"

name.description: The new name for the asset.

tags.description: The replacement tags for the asset.

actions.description: Update a folder name.
actions.name: update-folder

name.description: The new folder name. Example: My awesome holiday

syncs.description: Sync pages for configured Canva designs.
syncs.name: design-pages

syncs.description: Sync the contents of configured Canva folders.
syncs.name: folder-items
